grounding.from: Hours are inconsistent. Apple Maps shows it closed on Monday, October 12, 2026. Waze and Yellow Pages show Monday 9:00 am to 8:30 pm. Yelp shows Monday 10:00 am to 8:30 pm.

value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there's no open Costco in Oakville yet. The one going in near the QEW is slated to open in 2027. The closest open ones I found are Burlington at 1225 Brant St and a Laird Rd warehouse in Mississauga, which one deals site says also serves Oakville. I don't have drive times, so I can't say which is closer. Burlington's hours differ between listings, so don't count on a Monday schedule.
